title: CCSbench: Critical Code Studies Workbench on bench-kit
description: The successor to CCS-WB-classic, rebuilt on the critical-code-studies/bench-kit framework shared with the SHRDLU, Spacewar!, ELIZA and Melville benches. CCSbench is a browser-based project builder for the close reading of code as cultural artefact: six typed line-anchored annotations (Observation, Question, Metaphor, Pattern, Context, Critique), bench-kit's Kintsugi repair register (hibi / yobitsugi / kake) with gold rendering of mended lines and Flatten-to-child-version, side-by-side comparison of two files within one project (Beside) and of two versions of one program (Collate / Genealogy / Book's Compare), and a settings panel for the project's own identity, references, language and GitHub locations. The AI module from CCS-WB-classic has been dropped for the v1 line.
